\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 232-233 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R236-first-pass-words-from-chapters-232-233}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an assembly and a journalist.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a cucumber, a mushroom, maize, chickpeas, the internet
  \item a metre, a packet, a tin, a sack, small change
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cucumber? (\textbf{\bn{শসা}}, \emph{shôsā}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{\bn{মাশরুম}}, \emph{māshrum}.) Maize? (\textbf{\bn{ভুট্টা}}, \emph{bhuṭṭā}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\bn{ছোলা}}, \emph{chholā}.) The internet? (\textbf{\bn{ইন্টারনেট}}, \emph{inṭārneṭ}.) A metre? (\textbf{\bn{মিটার}}, \emph{miṭār}.) A packet? (\textbf{\bn{প্যাকেট}}, \emph{pækeṭ}.) A tin? (\textbf{\bn{টিন}}, \emph{ṭin}.) A sack? (\textbf{\bn{বস্তা}}, \emph{bôstā}.) Small change? (\textbf{\bn{খুচরো}}, \emph{khuchro}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 234-236 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R236-second-pass-words-from-chapters-234-236}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a vial and a memory.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a vial, a memory, a thought; a worry, looks, behaviour; use
  \item a meeting, an employee, a colleague, a cobbler, a carpenter
  \item a class, a worker, a contract, an assembly, a journalist
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A vial? (\textbf{\bn{শিশি}}, \emph{shishi}.) A memory? (\textbf{\bn{স্মৃতি}}, \emph{smriti}.) A thought; a worry? (\textbf{\bn{চিন্তা}}, \emph{chintā}.) Looks? (\textbf{\bn{চেহারা}}, \emph{chehārā}.) Behaviour; use? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যবহার}}, \emph{bæbôhār}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\bn{মিটিং}}, \emph{miṭing}.) An employee? (\textbf{\bn{কর্মচারী}}, \emph{kôrmôchārī}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\bn{সহকর্মী}}, \emph{sôhôkôrmī}.) A cobbler? (\textbf{\bn{মুচি}}, \emph{muchi}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\bn{ছুতোর}}, \emph{chhutor}.) A class? (\textbf{\bn{ক্লাস}}, \emph{klās}.) A worker? (\textbf{\bn{কর্মী}}, \emph{kôrmī}.) A contract? (\textbf{\bn{চুক্তি}}, \emph{chukti}.) An assembly? (\textbf{\bn{সভা}}, \emph{sôbhā}.) A journalist? (\textbf{\bn{সাংবাদিক}}, \emph{sāngbādik}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
